desc: For a sharp, comfortable Kershaw at an affordable price, add a Korra to your pocket. This Starter Series knife opens nearly effortlessly with assisted opening. The blade features a high hollow grind with slicey cutting ability and is easy to resharpen. Its contoured handle shape fits like a glove in-hand, and texturing offers even greater control for long periods of time. When not in use, the compact design carries reliably in-pocket with a reversible deep-carry pocket clip. Well-rounded for most cutting tasks, the Korra delivers.
